lastCompletedStory.title: Guard toml read behind non-empty candidates

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-264) wrapped makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn's project.toml read (parseToml(readProjectToml())), issue_prefix resolution, and resolveIssueId(parentIssue) call behind a `candidates.length > 0` guard, extracted into a new private helper `fileCandidates` (also wraps the candidate-filing for-loop) to keep the closure under Biome's noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity(15) ceiling -- adding the guard as an inline `if` pushed complexity to 19. The post-loop logEvent block (fires on filedIds.length>0 || dupSkipped>0 || failedCount>0) stays OUTSIDE the guard, so the all-duplicates path (candidates empty, dupSkipped>0) still emits its audit event with filedIds:[] and failedCount:0. Two new tests added in a 'US-001' describe block at the end of test/supervisor/suggestion-filing-production.test.ts, both using a new makeTempProjectDirNoToml helper (a temp cwd with NO scripts/cam/project.toml file at all): (1) zero-SUGGESTIONs report never reads the toml (would throw ENOENT if it did), (2) all-duplicates path (2 findings, both already filed) never reads the toml either, and still emits the suggestion-filed event with the expected detail shape. Raised scripts/file-size-budget.json ceilings for src/commands/sidecar.ts (2467->2494) and test/supervisor/suggestion-filing-production.test.ts (367->445), staged in the same commit with a dated _ref note. No vendor/templates touched, no embed-vendor concern.
